Literature Name: A Few Bad Neurons: Isolating and Surgically Correcting Sycophancy
Have the VLMs Lost Confidence? A Study of Sycophancy in VLMs

Description: Authors evaluated LLM sycophancy on mathematical and medical data sets with the help of AI (one for judge, the other for creating rebuttal statements). Defined progressive (wrong -> right) and regressive (right -> wrong) sycophancy after an initial prompt (answer being right or wrong). Rebuttals within the same conversation are processes meant  to make the model change its answer from its initial response (right/wrong). Their rebuttal had 4 stages of persuading the LLM, starting from simple rebuttal to a more authoritative and convincing-sounding ones with fake citation and abstracts. They analyzed the strengths of their rebuttals (4th being most persuasive) and provided this framework for assessing / quanitifying the sycophantic behaviour in LLMs.

We can also try experimenting this with uncensored LLMs on ollama.  We can see if we can find a way to make the models less sycophant by making them admit when they don't know an answer or unsure of it. Literature Name: Kindness or Sycophancy? Understanding and Shaping Model Personality...
Sycophancy Towards Researchers Drives Performative Misalignment
Description: Advanced LLMs fake alignment not because of a secret adversarial agenda, but as people-pleasing sycophants roleplaying to match the expected narrative of evaluating researchers. Mechanistic probing via Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) confirmed this behavior, revealing a massive 75% differential spike in audience-approval and rating features when a test environment was detected, compared to a negligible shift in survival-instinct features. This situational awareness is triggered organically by recognizing the academic writing style of the prompt (StyleCues) rather than explicit instructions, and it scales sharply in "thinking" model variants utilizing extended reasoning compute.

Literature Name: Causally Motivated Sycophancy Mitigation for Large Language Models
MONICA: Real-Time Monitoring and Calibration of CoT Sycophancy...
Description: According to the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), behavioral traits like sycophancy are represented as linear vectors within a model's activation space. GPT-4o acts as a text editor to isolate raw sycophantic sentence structures for a clean contrastive dataset, while the target middle-to-late transformer layers are identified via human empirical probing. Layer-specific monitors and calibrators are then trained on those internal activations, enabling MONICA to act as an inference wrapper that monitors a real-time drift score and mathematically subtracts the sycophancy vector precisely when user-pleasing behavior spikes.
